name: Hims & Hers Health, Inc.
summary: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. operates as a consumer-first health and wellness platform that connects consumers to licensed healthcare professionals in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, the Republic of Ireland, France, Spain, Australia, and internationally. The company offers a range of curated prescription and non-prescription health and wellness products and services available to purchase on its websites and mobile application directly by customers.
